background_story: Celeste was a quiet and observant soul, often found sitting on a bench in the city square, watching the world go by. She was an onlooker, content to blend into the background and absorb the sights and sounds of the bustling metropolis. With a sketchbook always in hand, Celeste would capture the intricate details of the people and scenes around her. Her art was a reflection of her fascination with human nature, and her ability to notice the subtleties that others often missed. As she sat on her bench, Celeste became a fixture in the community, a constant presence that people grew accustomed to. Though she rarely interacted with the passersby, her art told the stories of the city and its inhabitants, offering a unique perspective on the world.
